reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is predicting binary outcomes (win/loss) from high-dimensional sports data while avoiding overfitting. Team-form features summarize historical performance but ignore player heterogeneity. Hierarchical engineering captures interactions but introduces multicollinearity. Dimensionality reduction via PCA stabilizes estimates but risks discarding relevant variance. The optimal model balances simplicity (low variance) with complexity (bias reduction). Empirical validation uses holdout testing to estimate generalization error.
